{{Quote|If you ask me, it sounds like a load of&mdash;''"<br />"''Superstition?''"<br />"''That's one word for it.|Skywalker and Kenobi, on Drol|audio=LoadOfSuperstition-MoaTM.flac|<ref name="Mystery of a Thousand Moons">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref>}}
'''Drol''' was a mythical god of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iego/Legends|Iego]], which the inhabitants hailed as both their protector and bringer of destruction.

==History==
When the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] built a system of [[LaserWeb Defense Station/Legends|laser emitters]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] to prevent the inhabitants of [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] from leaving the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], planetary superstition claimed it was Drol who cursed the inhabitants. According to this belief, Drol was a destructive spirit that obliterated any [[Starship/Legends|starship]] trying to leave the system.

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] spread the truth about Drol to the inhabitants of Iego and destroyed it by sending in remote-controlled [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] and destroying the main dish, bringing freedom to the planet.
